evaluation_blinding: candidate rationale and component counts hidden

product_truth.state: accountable Work with evidence returned for owner decision
product_truth.lesson: calm operational density, exact state language, mint reserved for agency and decision
product_truth.non_transferable: navigation chrome and dense tables are not copied into every public composition

references.license: MIT; exact local adaptation must retain provenance
references.lesson: material and motion can make state change tangible
references.non_transferable: a primitive is not a mandate, template or quality score

references.lesson: simple value-first copy and product-native typography outperform academic explanation
references.non_transferable: one landing layout cannot become the email, product and social layout

shared_grammar.typography: IBM Plex Sans and Mono; large plain value statement; operational annotations
shared_grammar.composition: one outcome, visible mechanism, adjacent proof, decisive action
shared_grammar.colour: quiet ink and paper; mint marks agency or accepted state; warm colour only for scoped social departure
shared_grammar.motion: reveals causal progress; complete at-rest replacement under reduced motion
shared_grammar.product_representation: exact current UI or visibly abstract; no uncanny pseudo-interface

anti_examples.name: goofy blob proof
anti_examples.reason: abstract material pretends to be product evidence

anti_examples.name: tiny diagram theatre
anti_examples.reason: labels become illegible and communicate architecture instead of value

anti_examples.name: component-count flex
anti_examples.reason: novelty competes with hierarchy and proof

anti_examples.name: one template everywhere
anti_examples.reason: same composition ignores native channel constraints

decision: The restrained control wins wherever an effect does not improve state, meaning or emphasis.
